verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync, a paid add-on, documents collaborating on a shared vault with a team, and version history lets you restore earlier versions of a note. Nothing in the pack shows real-time co-editing or conflict handling. A community member notes that Google-Docs-style collaboration needed a separate CRDT plugin, and that Android sync mid-edit can drop the last lines of a note. Missing for 10: native real-time simultaneous editing, documented conflict resolution/merge behavior, and independent corroboration that shared-vault collaboration works smoothly.
